The outcome (Y): ba_share_2011 minus ba_share_2001, in percentage points of Birmingham's Black African population. Positive = the area gained share of the group, whatever happened to the group's total; it adds up to exactly 0 across the areas of a layer

Second version of Y: asinh(y_change / 0.1). Zero still means no change and the sign is kept; values near zero are almost unchanged and large values are pulled in (skewness 0.96 and kurtosis 23 for y_change among LSOAs become about 0.0 and 3.3). The 0.1 is fixed for LSOA-sized values, so it compresses the larger MSOA, ward and constituency values more
